---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Grady Woodard"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb")
dbplyr_dist <- dplyr::tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, year, rla_score) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score) |>
  filter(!is.na(`2015`), !is.na(`2023`)) |>
  mutate(score_change = `2023` - `2015`) |>
  select(district_id, score_change) |>
  collect()

state_change <- dplyr::tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(state = stateabb, year, rla_score) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score) |>
  filter(!is.na(`2015`), !is.na(`2023`)) |>
  mutate(score_change = `2023` - `2015`) |>
  select(state, `2015`, `2023`, score_change) |>
  collect()

print(state_change)
dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  rename(rla_change = score_change) |>
  mutate(change_sign = ifelse(rla_change > 0, "Positive", "Negative")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = change_sign)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, color = "white", boundary = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "steelblue", "Negative" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("District count:", nrow(score_change)),
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement from 2015 to 2023.",
    x = "Change in reading score (2023 - 2015)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change direction"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  mutate(
    state = forcats::fct_reorder(state, `2023`),
    change_direction = if_else(score_change > 0, "Increase", "Decrease")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = state)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = `2015`, xend = `2023`, yend = state, color = change_direction),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `2015`), color = "gray55", size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increase" = "steelblue", "Decrease" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores, 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows show the direction and size of each state's score change",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrowheads mark 2023 scores.",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Change"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
